summary: SEALSQ Corp, a British Virgin Islands-incorporated semiconductor issuer listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) covering interim condensed consolidated financial statements as of June 30, 2026, incorporating them by reference into its Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. Results show first-half net sales of $11.2 million versus $4.8 million, an operating loss of $32.2 million, and a net loss attributable to SEALSQ of $27.7 million, with cash of approximately $479.8 million. The filing discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor; it is a routine periodic financial-results disclosure with no special-situations mechanics, so there is no deal or event-driven risk-arb angle to watch.
